You don’t have neighbors who would call the police? The police just magically know your house is going to be broken into? You don’t know how this works. You locking the door is you trying to prevent someone from entering your house. You maintaining good relationships with your neighbors where they would actually care if someone was breaking into your house. You actually asking them to watch your house in case you’re worried that someone might do it. You putting security cameras up is trying to prevent that. I didn’t know the police just had powers of knowing what house was being broken into. I guess if someone lives in the middle of nowhere and they don’t have any neighbors, they leave their doors unlocked there’s no one around for miles. They live alone they leave their doors open. No security system. Not even a Ring doorbell. I guess the police can just magically know that someone’s breaking into their house if they never call the police. If you got an email or a letter of someone threatening to break into your house why are you not going to it with the police? Are you just expecting them to magically know that the letter was sent? At the very least you’re not going to be making sure all the doors are locked. All the windows are locked. And be sitting with the phone in hand, looking out a window. Ready to call the police at any moment you hear the slightest sound. Where are you going to do if there’s a fire at your house you just hope the firefighters can smell the smoke.

replies.author: @Enric.
replies.text:
​@Zachary-b6x What? If I murdered someone who tried to break into my house, the police would intervene immediately without my permission. They would invade my house and search it thoroughly. They would arrest me, judge me, and imprison me. They would remove the victim's body from my house. And even without killing anyone, I have to pay taxes to live in my own home. I need to ask the government's permission to do any sort of home improvement, and pay taxes for it, or fines if I don't. Because my house is not my country, And the government controls everything, regulates everything, and enforces its laws.

The population of North Sentinel Island is not controlled by anyone, but themselves.
